spans.label: plonky2 and crate imports
spans.note: `use` lines. plonky2 builder/proof/config API, the keccak gadget, the cyclic verifier-data helpers and the recursive-verification helpers are opaque callbacks or premises in the model; no lowering is refined.

spans.label: WITHDRAWAL_STEP_PUBLIC_INPUTS_LEN constant
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the 8 + 15 word split is pinned as a literal and proved equal to its component constants.

spans.label: WithdrawalStepPublicInputsError variants
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the four failure modes are represented as constructors of the module's single Error type. Display strings are not modeled.

spans.label: WithdrawalStepPublicInputs statement
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the verifier-only data is carried as an opaque word list, not as a plonky2 structure.

spans.label: impl header and where clause
spans.note: Trait bounds and impl header with no executable content.

spans.label: to_u64_vec serialization order
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the concatenation order hash-chain || public-state || vd is modeled and its length proved.

spans.label: from_u64_slice decoder
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; length guard, u32 limb range checks, the 63-bit block-number check and the absence of a range check on the three Poseidon roots are all modeled. The field-element to u64 conversion is a boundary.

spans.label: WithdrawalStepPublicInputsTarget statement
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the in-circuit statement carries the same three components as the native one. Target allocation itself is not modeled here.

spans.label: target allocation (Bytes32 checked, PublicState unchecked, virtual verifier data)
spans.note: Not modeled: virtual-target allocation and the checked/unchecked flags of this constructor. This constructor is unused by the step circuit, which builds its statement from computed wires instead.

spans.label: target to_vec serialization order
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the target serialization order matches the native one and is modeled by the same definition.

spans.label: from_pis offsets
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the cursor offsets are modeled. The source's assert!/expect panics here are represented as decoder errors, not as a distinct panic outcome.

spans.label: target set_witness plumbing
spans.note: Not modeled: PartialWitness assignment order for the statement targets.

spans.label: WithdrawalStepError variants
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the six failure modes map onto constructors of the module's Error type, including the propagated UpdatePublicState error.

spans.label: WithdrawalStepWitness fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; proofs are opaque records carrying only their public-input words.

spans.label: impl header and where clause
spans.note: Trait bounds and impl header with no executable content.

spans.label: to_public_inputs: native step admission and the WDR-CRIT-001 fold
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics in source order: update_public_state.verify, single-withdrawal proof verification, statement decode, old==single.public_state, the previous-chain branch forcing new==prev.public_state, the leaf fold and the emission of update.new. Proof verification itself is an opaque callback; nothing here asserts that a verifying proof is sound.

spans.label: impl close and blank line
spans.note: Closing brace and whitespace.

spans.label: WithdrawalStepTarget wires
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the target record is represented by the witness values its wires carry, not by plonky2 Target identities.

spans.label: builder setup: is_initial, not_initial, UpdatePublicStateTarget
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the boolean-safe is_initial wire and the nested public-state update gate set are modeled. The nested gate set is reused from the imported UpdatePublicState module; its Merkle/hash lowering stays a boundary.

spans.label: previous chain proof target and conditionally_verify_proof
spans.note: Recursive verification is NOT modeled. Only the statement a previous proof carries and the fact that verification is gated on not_initial are represented; cyclic soundness is an undischarged premise.

spans.label: conditionally_connect_vd of the carried verifier data
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the conditional equality is modeled exactly, including the fact that on the initial step it degenerates to a tautology and leaves the carried verifier data a free witness.

spans.label: add_proof_target_and_verify for the single-withdrawal proof
spans.note: Unconditional recursive verification against a fixed verifier data; modeled only as an opaque predicate on the proof.

spans.label: SingleWithdawalPublicInputsTarget::from_vec offsets
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the 15 + 30 word split of the single-withdrawal statement is modeled and pinned.

spans.label: connect update_public_state.old to the single withdrawal public state
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the unconditional connect is the StepGates.oldConnectedToSingle equation.

spans.label: WDR-CRIT-001 conditional_assert_eq of update.new against the previous statement
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the conditional equality is modeled and the chain-level consequence (one canonical public state across every step) is derived by induction over a linked chain of statements.

spans.label: zero-hash select and Withdrawal::hash_with_prev_hash
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the is_initial select onto Bytes32::default() and the keccak leaf fold are modeled. The keccak gadget is an opaque callback and is never assumed injective.

spans.label: new_pis construction and returned target record
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the emitted statement is update_public_state.new (not .old) plus the conditionally connected verifier data, and a native accepting run is shown to give a satisfying local witness.

spans.label: target set_witness plumbing and dummy-proof substitution
spans.note: Not modeled: PartialWitness assignment order, the dummy-proof substitution on the initial step, and the fact that the natively computed statement is written onto wires the circuit also computes.

spans.label: WithdrawalStepCircuit record of plonky2 artifacts
spans.note: CircuitData, ProofWithPublicInputs and VerifierCircuitData are compiler/proof-system artifacts held opaque.

spans.label: circuit construction, public-input registration and dummy proof
spans.note: builder.build and DummyProof are boundaries. Only the ORDER in which register_public_inputs emits the statement words is modeled, by StepPublicInputs.toU64Vec.

spans.label: prove and verify entry points
spans.note: plonky2 proving/verification is opaque. Only the native statement construction that prove performs first is modeled.

spans.label: cfg(test) module
spans.note: Test harness with TestCyclicCircuit stand-ins; not a production constraint.

boundaries.name: keccak-callback
boundaries.obligation: solidity_keccak256 and builder.keccak256 are opaque callbacks; the model never assumes injectivity, collision resistance, or that the native and in-circuit digests coincide.

boundaries.name: cyclic-recursion-soundness
boundaries.obligation: conditionally_verify_proof and add_proof_target_and_verify are modeled only by the statement each proof carries. That a verifying recursive proof implies its statement was produced by an accepting step is undischarged.

boundaries.name: initial-step-free-verifier-data
boundaries.obligation: On the initial step conditionally_connect_vd degenerates to a tautology, so the carried verifier data is an unconstrained witness there. It is pinned only through a successor step or the outer wrapper anchor.

boundaries.name: public-state-history
boundaries.obligation: UpdatePublicState's Merkle opening, hash lowering and the claim that a root belongs to real on-chain history are inherited as undischarged premises.

boundaries.name: single-withdrawal-statement
boundaries.obligation: The single-withdrawal circuit's own soundness (that its statement really witnesses a spendable balance at that public state) is outside this model.

boundaries.name: witness-assignment
boundaries.obligation: PartialWitness assignment, dummy-proof substitution and generator/gate lowering are not modeled; a satisfying StepGates witness is not shown to correspond to a real plonky2 witness.

boundaries.name: field-element-encoding
boundaries.obligation: The u64/field-element correspondence used by to_u64_vec and to_field_vec is assumed, not proved.
